settings.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
settings.answer: MOQ varies by product. Contact us with the products and quantities you need, and we will provide the applicable MOQ.

settings.question: Do you offer OEM and ODM services?
settings.answer: Yes. We can support customization of product shape, size, color, material, branding and packaging depending on the project.

settings.question: Can I request a private label?
settings.answer: Yes. Private label options are available for suitable products and order quantities.

settings.question: Can you supply different silicone product categories?
settings.answer: Yes. Our product range covers kitchenware, food storage, baby, pet, household, bathroom, beauty, and outdoor & sports categories.

settings.question: How can I request a quotation?
settings.answer: Use our Request a Quote form and include the products, estimated quantity, target market and customization requirements. Our sales team will follow up with the relevant details.

settings.question: Do you support international B2B orders?
settings.answer: Yes. We work with global wholesalers, retailers, distributors and brands and can discuss shipping and order requirements for your market.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.intro: Answers to common questions from global B2B buyers.
